annotations.title: Post readings recorded since my last sync

description: For an integration keeping its own copy of the brand's post numbers: a cursor feed of every reading recorded since the cursor, across all of the brand's posts, in one call instead of one per post. FIRST call with no cursor: it returns no rows and the current cursor; store it, then call with it to receive only what was recorded after (pass back the cursor each page returns; hasMore says there is another page). fromStart:true pages through every reading held instead. Each row is one reading: the post, when it was read, and the numbers as the platform reported them (or the failure). Read-only, 0 credits.

brand.description: profile id/name from list_brands, this call only
